prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 92.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 94.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 76.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom Pet Generation Lighting and Pose Guide Workspace: Redesign the photo upload step into a spotlight workspace with real-time photo framing and lighting guidance before rendering. (why: Support emails show 3 complaints about custom pet rendering failing or looking wrong, and adoption step dropoff is high at 73.1%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen: Insert a dedicated interactive tutorial screen before final completion showing key desktop pet interaction shortcuts. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Spawntime Interactive Mini Sandbox Flow: Add an interactive desktop sandbox workspace screen during pet generation so users can customize desktop accessories while waiting. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201 seconds (mean 2336s), causing dropoff during long asset rendering.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Profile Pet Preservation Security Hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in links pet memory and customizations permanently to prevent loss. (why: Support logged 8 complaints about lost pets after signing in.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Milestone Companion Badge Incentive: Display an official pet guardian achievement badge on the adoption certificate screen upon path completion. (why: Adoption step conversion is low at 73.1%; adding clear reward incentives reinforces commitment.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Diagnostic Progress Tracker: Show real-time progress indicators and desktop transparency check status on the waiting screen. (why: 3 support emails report pets failing to show on desktop, and waiting screen dropoff is noticeable.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet First Interaction Launch Headline: Update home_intro text to clearly describe where the pet appears and how to invoke the key control shortcut. (why: Finish step dropoff is 23.9% (76.1% conversion) and support reports post-onboarding interaction confusion.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Instant Companion Setup Time Copy Clarification: Include estimated completion time in the path choice headline and hint to clarify fast versus photo setup. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514 seconds; setting clear time expectations speeds up decision-making.)
